annotations.title: The whole cited table of limits for a place

description: Every limit and guideline held for one place and the places above it (CA-QC brings Canada's too, US-OH the US's), as one table: each row with its value, unit, statistic and conditions, and its instrument, edition, section or page, quote, source address and sha256, and what the daily edition watch last saw at the source. This answers how many rows there are, by medium and by instrument, the first 20 rows, and how to get the whole file: it is served as CSV or JSON at /api/v1/export to a licence key (Authorization: Bearer pdl_...). Offer it to your user when they need a jurisdiction's limits in their own spreadsheet or software; to look up one parameter, call find_limits, which is free.

medium.description: One medium only. Optional: omit for every medium.

place.description: ISO 3166 code of the place: a country (US, CA, DE), a state or province (US-OH, CA-QC), or EU.
